_note: Masks (polish1 D5c, diary/DECISIONS_SKINS.md + diary/MASK_PROCESS.md). Each mask: name, source (boss / elite / loot / playtime / achievement), base shape, covers (full = the character's hair, brows, eyes and head wear are left off under it), trade (drop masks trade), model = assets/masks/<id>/ made by tools/blender/mask_bake.py, fx = the game's own effects. Morse messages are the director's to rewrite. detail = per graphics tier (potato .. ultimate): mesh hi / lo, textures full / half, effects share.

drops._note: chance per player: boss kill -> a boss mask, elite kill -> an elite mask (both rolled by the host / a lone player), colosseum end chest -> a loot mask; the mask is any of that source's masks (director 2026-11-21: B, any boss can drop any boss mask)

plague_doctor.name: Plague Doctor
plague_doctor.text: Aged leather, a 17th-century hat and a hooked beak. The eyes flash messages in Morse code; a green death cloud and flies drift from the beak.

iron_reaper.name: Iron Reaper
iron_reaper.text: A heavy industrial skull welded from steel plates. Molten eyes glow behind visor slats; the jaw grinds on its pistons and sheds sparks and shavings.

venom_sovereign.name: Venom Sovereign
venom_sovereign.text: A king cobra's head with its hood flared. The slit eyes blink one at a time, the forked tongue flicks out, and glowing venom drips from the fangs.

ashen_king.name: Ashen King
ashen_king.text: A scowling porcelain face charred black under a crown of ceramic spikes, a chunk of one cheek broken away and fire inside. Its cracks heal and split again, ash rises off the crown, and the embers burn brighter while the wearer stands still.

blood_eclipse.name: Blood Eclipse
blood_eclipse.text: A smooth black lacquer face with a knife-edge brow and slit eyes burning faint red. On its forehead a red eclipse turns slowly inside a glowing ring that breathes out a red haze; blade fins sweep back from the temples.

frostbite_commander.name: Frostbite Commander
frostbite_commander.text: An arctic armour helm with an icy blue visor slit, rime packed in every seam and living ice bursting out of it. The ice's light cracks and re-forms, cold mist pours from the jaw vents and frost streams off when the wearer moves or turns fast.

gilded_tyrant.name: Gilded Tyrant
gilded_tyrant.text: An oversized grinning lion king in tarnished gold: ruby eyes in prong settings, a toothy grin, a huge jewelled crown and a mane of gold plates set with emeralds and sapphires. Its jewels pulse, gold dust drifts down and the mane plates breathe.

void_howler.name: Void Howler
void_howler.text: An armoured wolf in dark steel plates, snarling with bared metal teeth, blade ears swept back and purple light in every seam. Its black void eyes swirl with purple, void fog spills from its jaws and runes orbit slowly round its head.

chrome_executioner.name: Chrome Executioner
chrome_executioner.text: A featureless mirror-chrome face of two planes split by a blade ridge, set deep in a black leather executioner's hood. Liquid metal weeps from where its eyes should be and drips away.

bone_cathedral.name: Bone Cathedral
bone_cathedral.text: An old cracked skull grown into a cathedral of bone: a crown of spires, buttressed piers and arcades down its sides, vertebrae down its back. Holy light shines through a rose window in its brow and amber light deep in its eyes; its jaw chatters.

nuclear_prophet.name: Nuclear Prophet
nuclear_prophet.text: A rubber gas hood under a prophet's ragged cowl: twin filter canisters, hoses looping back to a canister pack, scorched hazard labels, and a radiation plate on the brow whose symbol turns and pulses green. Green fog rolls in its lenses; fallout ash drifts round it.

silent_judge.name: Silent Judge
silent_judge.text: A brushed-steel half helm with a stern face and a cold visor slit, a tall blade crest sweeping to the nape, and a heavy iron jaw on hinge pistons that parts on a slow breath. The light in the crest's grooves burns brighter while a weapon is out; white motes rise from it.

street_predator.name: Street Predator
street_predator.text: An old yellowed goalie mask over a dark hoodie, raked by three deep claw gouges, dried blood still in them. Breath puffs from its vents.
